'''Edvaalda''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who lived on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. She worked as a bartender in the [[Dealer's Den]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in the [[Old Galactic Market]].

==Behind the scenes==
Edvaalda appears in the [[BioWare]] MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a cantina vendor on Coruscant.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
